fact: Tech-ish reports SpaceX switched Starlink on in Seychelles on 18 July 2026, two days after Cote d'Ivoire, making it one of 28 African countries where the service is on sale.
State House reports SCRA representatives said Starlink has been authorised to operate in Seychelles under the national regulatory framework, as outlined at the soft-launch press conference.

State House reports the soft launch of Starlink on 21 July 2026: households and businesses can subscribe and order kits through Starlink's online platform, and some people already use kits; a formal launch is to follow.

Connecting Africa reports Starlink confirmed service available in Seychelles on 20 July 2026 and the country shows as available on its map; residential plan SCR1,077 a month, residential lite SCR769, standard kit SCR6,725, Mini kit SCR5,322; the Vice President said an official launch would follow.

Seychelles Nation reports the Vice President told the National Assembly Starlink was incorporated locally and in the final stages of its licensing process, so not yet licensed, as of Tuesday 26 May 2026.
Seychelles Nation reports the Cabinet approved an ISP licence for Starlink on 18 February 2026, subject to conditions, with the LTA to assess impacts on existing operators before full rollout.

State House Seychelles reports that Starlink began operations in Seychelles with a soft launch at State House on 24 July 2026, presided over by the Vice-President alongside the SCRA, for households, businesses and students.

SCRA officials confirmed that Starlink has been authorized to operate in Seychelles under the telecommunications regulations; no authorisation date is given, so the article's publication date is used.

Households and businesses can subscribe via Starlink's online platform, buying the hardware kit and activating service after a soft launch at State House; officials said several users already have equipment and are using the service.
Le360 reports the Seychelles Council of Ministers approved on 18 February 2026 an internet service provider licence for Starlink, subject to conditions, covering the country's 115 islands.

Seychelles Cabinet, meeting on 18 February 2026, approved the issuance of an ISP licence, subject to specific conditions, to Starlink to provide broadband Internet services and related products in Seychelles; the document is dated 19 February 2026 and gives no separate licence date.
